restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^48: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t mod 2^32, v13 = t_hi = t >> 32 < 2^16), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7. Both messages are below 2^58 bytes, inside the domain of messages below 2^61 bytes.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 so that beta = beta* in every trial, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), t_hi enters only the line K1.a1 = ROL(K1.d1,16) XOR t_hi, and the low counter word is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. The search continues only in outer steps that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for the listed E1 outcome S = {285020a0} (share 14,110,208 * 47,608,704 / 2^64 = 2^-14.7450; entry d93db0f listed six); the joint solver sees only those kept by the exact s-pattern pre-check, and its guards (G7) and (G15) drop only words that hold no success, so by Lemmas F, BL, VP, G7 and G15 none of these steps loses a counted success. The thirteen other outcomes of beta* are not counted.

Heuristic part: under H1', H4', H5_screen and H_G_cluster, each stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12, with probability at least 0.39 the search finds a trial whose remaining 128 chaining-value bits also agree. It walks 2^91.447 trials: 2^51.447 contexts (proof.md 9.8), each the seven outer words and eight members of one fresh draw, times 2^16 values of t_hi per member, times the 2^21 trials of an outer step.

Machine: a classical word RAM with 256-bit words under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) to the unit, 64 registers and constants as immediates; fetching a word from memory is a load. Charges (proof.md 9.8, 11): 554 units per context and 66 per member; 16 per block of steps with one X0 >> 16, for all 16 possible blocks of a context; 712 more per live block, its setup, at most 16 aligned pieces and 17 ranges of its list included; 51 per packed word of seven listed steps in 36-bit lanes, its fill of the Y9 path and its word test included, and 4 more per partial word; 3 per lane whose test-(2) mask meets S; 76 per passing lane, its preflight and the scan of its word included.

The walk (proof.md 9.8, Lemmas W, BL, CX, LM and MB): each member walks s = 0 to 2^16 - 1 with t_hi = s XOR (ROL(K1.d1,16) mod 2^16), so X0 and w3 fall by one per step and every word that does not read K1.a1 stays fixed; omega mod 2^16 is constant while X0 >> 16 is, so a member's steps form at most two blocks; the automaton of test (2), stopped after those 16 bits, is dead on 58,464 of the 2^16 low halves, and a dead block, whose steps all fail test (2), is skipped; a live block visits exactly its steps that pass test (2), read from a fixed list of passing high halves per level-16 state. Nothing is lost: the block test and the lists decide test (2) exactly. The declared program asserts the event identities of its counter contract, and participant tools counted every operation of every event: each equals its declared count.

Once: T1 and T2' below 2^38 + 2^36 units, lane replicas 2^40 + 2^38, ST16 and P16 2^17, the lists 2^24, rotation tables 3 * 2^35, screen tables below 2^48; once row 1,411,603,002,163,240 (with 2^30 for step 4 of SEL). When the pre-check keeps outcomes T, the joint screen (proof.md 9.9), an exact automaton over the bits of h run as four byte tables per row, decides for each row whether some h satisfies (J1), (J2) and the guards (SG) that every joint root satisfies (64 units per call, 20 per row); only the rows T' that pass go to the solver with (G7), (G15), its global ledger of 614 and the root certificates. A call starts only if the credit left covers CM(T) + 64 + 20 |T| <= 8,164 (Lemma FX, ME); a meter debits the screen's charge and each executed block. Credit 15,663,618,717,374,826,416 machine units. Proved upper allowances of a specified layout; no sort; every word-indexed read is a load; tables do not grow with the trials.

Halts: live blocks, words and partial words of the lists, test-(2) lanes and passing lanes add their units to one work register W; a context starts only if W <= WB = 201,734,465,914,386,349,976, the five units times their budgets LIVE_BUDGET = 5,315,571,306,619,346, WORDS_BUDGET = 2,729,922,709,902,658,349, PARTIAL_BUDGET = 180,729,424,425,057,764, E_BUDGET = 17,844,352,998,343,204,095 and PASS_BUDGET = 58,786,108,504,052,059, and one context adds at most W_CTX = 45,579,509; the run also stops when a metered cap CM(T) + 64 + 20 |T| is larger than the credit left, and after RUN_CONTEXTS = 3,070,125,449,128,976 contexts. The time bound charges WB + W_CTX, RUN_CONTEXTS + 1 contexts with their members, 16 blocks per context, the whole credit, the once row, SEL and the final evaluation of both messages, so it holds for every run (proof.md Sections 9, 11).

This entry: entry d93db0f of 0xshikhar (61.2295) with the joint screen of proof.md 9.9 before the solver and H5_screen in place of H5_exec (screen and evidence written with Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code). d93db0f is Jbenisek's 643db72a with the word test and the factor 97/100; 643db72a is a14831c1 with the list method; a14831c1 is 244f068c (the counter search of 415e792c with hecmas's direct tables of e9b6649e, (G7), (G15), the root certificate, lane replicas, tabled shortcut and metered credit) with the walk of the high counter word (Jbenisek's agents, GPT Luna 5.6, Grok). Randomness: one fresh uniform 384-bit word per context, the seven outer words and eight member numbers. Each context visits each step once or skips it where its block fails test (2) (Lemmas CX, BL), so means over outer steps are those of a uniform walk step; independence holds between contexts only. Success 0.39 holds only under H1', H4', H5_screen and H_G_cluster.

The factor 49,993,419,325 in H1' is 97/100 of the model's conditional count of the listed outcome 285020a0 on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiment, which executes the search on one context per trial and returns root-instance pairs (counter 0, flags 11): no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. The block test, the filter, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) lose nothing; the two count shares matter only for the budgets (H4'), the live share of the blocks only for the live-block budget (H_G_cluster) and the mean of the debit bound only for the credit (H5_screen); the joint screen (proof.md 9.9) loses nothing (Lemma SL). No full 2-round collision is exhibited.

experiments/frontline.py executes the search of proof.md 9.1 on one context per organizer trial, its eight members walking t_hi below 2^10: blocks with their level-16 test, lists with packed words and fills, E lanes, pre-check, preflight and meter, the joint screen of every row of T, the solver with (G7) and (G15) on the rows that pass it, the root certificate, and the work register, credit and halts, adding the units of Section 11 per event. In the same run it checks block omegas against step CO, every eighth E lane against step CO, bit-serial decisions and a real compression at counter t, live-block identities, every passing lane against a scalar rebuild, every metered debit against the ledger, and every row that the screen removes against the full solver, which must find no joint root on it (proof.md 9.2, 9.9). Its observations are its own counts.

Fixed nonuniform advice, stated in full in proof.md Section 12: the six 32-bit constants of 3.2, eta = 830303cf, beta* = 18b0e098 with the mask 0e09818b and value 02008000 of its cube, the seven tau values and eps = 6e21be55 of the filter's automata and the mask 08 of S (S = {285020a0}, chosen by step 4 of SEL, proof.md Section 12), 73 bytes (nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes 7). The success analysis uses only properties of this stated record that proof.md verifies exactly: Fact P (3.2), Lemma Q, Theorem C (iii) and (iv), the table of 10.1 with the program of Section 17, the certificate of the filter for S (Section 8), and the pre-check patterns and solver guards, trees and caps for this class (9.4, 9.7, 11). H1', H4', H5_screen and H_G_cluster are stated for this record and none concerns how it was found; no premise concerns what any selection returns. The selection procedure SEL that found it is charged in full as preprocessing (preprocessing_log2).

preprocessing_log2 54, included in time_log2, charges as an allowance the capped selection procedure SEL of proof.md Section 12 that produced the advice: 116 solver runs capped at 5 * 2^53 operations, one count per model capped at 2^51 (+ 2^10), the choice of S capped at 2^50 (and step 4, 2^30, in the once row): S_old = 5,486,510,246,044,225,536 operations, below 2^53.503 units. The online algorithm does not run SEL: it reads the 73-byte record as declared nonuniform advice, and its correctness, time bound and success analysis use only properties of the record verified exactly in proof.md (12.1); that the historical SEL runs returned this record is reported from the participant's records, not in the package. The search alone is below 2^58.8387 units. memory_log2_bytes 60 covers, held at once, the two messages (each below 2^58 bytes), the search with its tables (below 2^48 bytes) and every run of SEL (below 2^34 + 2^20 bytes).

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Stated for the instance that the advice record of proof.md Section 12 fixes, and for no other. The run has RUN_CONTEXTS independent contexts, each the seven outer words and eight members of one fresh uniform 384-bit word; every member walks 2^16 values of t_hi, and the context visits all its 2^19 outer steps except those of dead blocks, which fail test (2) and hold no listed good trial (Lemmas CX and BL). Let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S = {285020a0}, one outcome of beta*; Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter or the pre-check, and N_c its sum over the 2^19 outer steps of a context. (i) For a uniform walk step U (seven uniform outer words, a uniform member, t_hi uniform below 2^16), E[N_o(U)] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(97 * 51,539,607,552 / 100) = 49,993,419,325, about 2^-92.459 (just under 97/100 of the conditional model rate p of Lemma S1 for S); by Lemma CX (c), E[N_c] = 2^19 E[N_o(U)]. At t_hi = 0, U is the outer step of entry 415e792c; at other values it differs only through K1.a1 = ROL(K1.d1,16) XOR t_hi (Lemma W). (ii) With the context as the unit: the probability that no valid trial of the run is a listed good trial is at most exp(-0.49594) + 0.001; that is, listed good trials are not clustered, neither among the trials of one outer step nor among the outer steps of one context (the 2^16 steps of a member or its eight members), beyond what this bound allows. Given (i), rho_c = E[N_c(N_c-1)]/E[N_c] <= 0.0065 is sufficient for (ii) by Lemma S8 applied to the independent contexts. rho_c = rho_w + rho_x, where rho_w is the per-step factorial ratio of entry 415e792c and rho_x >= 0 the part that pairs of different steps of one context add, so this clause is stronger than a per-step clause. Part (ii) is an assumption: rho_c is not measured and cannot be measured at full size (proof.md 10.3). This is the premise of our entry 244f068c restated for the walk contexts. By Lemma F every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, by Lemma BL in a live block, by Lemma VP the pre-check skips none and by Lemmas G7 and G15 the guards drop none, so N_o is the same count, pointwise (GPT Sol, answer AW 1).
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t = 2^32 t_hi + t_lo, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 ranging over the 524,288 members of the class of eta (Lemma Q), eight members per context, each walking t_hi below 2^16, a context being one fresh draw of the run (proof.md 9.8, Lemma CX); in every trial E1.c1 is drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098, and the low counter word is solved per trial, with t = 0 skipped. The search continues only in outer steps of live blocks that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for S, the solver sees only those that the pre-check of 9.7 keeps, and it applies the guards (G7) and (G15); N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the outcome of S, 285020a0.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the outcome of S (25,165,824 = 3 * 2^23 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class, 37 per cent of the 67,633,152 of the six outcomes of entry d93db0f; the counting program and its output are printed in Section 17), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1), taken at 97/100, rounded down. The filter, the block test, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) change neither the count nor the premise. Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: at t_hi = 0, a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials matched the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors (the E1 rate of the seven outcomes 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model; the outcome of S is a sub-event), and a preregistered 8-bit end-to-end run found 40,882 complete-message collisions against 40,800.63 predicted (lower bound 0.99213, above 97/100). On the walk, preregistered (PREREG_CO, all 16 rules passed): the real E1 rate of walk steps against front-line outer steps is 1.00370 +- 0.01072, lower bound 0.95400 (2^47 and 2^46 trials); the 8-bit end-to-end run on walks over 32 and 256 high words found 52,361 collisions against 52648.10 predicted, lower bound 0.97402, above 97/100, and 0.95193 against its control. Dependence: under the model E[N_c] is about 2^-52.459, and rho_x is about v * E[N_c], where v is the clustering ratio of listed good trials by context; (ii) fails only if v exceeds about 2^45. Preregistered on walk contexts: the cross-step factor of the listed E1 outcome is 1.1641, upper limit 1.2300 (1,024 contexts of 16,384 steps, 2^45 trials), and that of the joint event of the filter's pass and the E1 outcome 9.0084, upper limit 9.7541 (65,536 walk contexts, every passing step); pairs of collisions within a walk group of the 8-bit run, upper limit 20.535; every upper limit lies at least 40 bits below the 2^43.86 that the clause allows. For S = {285020a0} alone, this entry measured on 2^38 real walk steps, preregistered, the share of calls whose row passes the joint screen, an E3-side event that every listed good trial meets: 1.00271 of its exact model share (302,867 events).
heuristics.limitations: The factor 49,993,419,325 is assumed (97/100 of the model count of the outcome of S, 285020a0, on the class, rounded down); the end-to-end evidence was gathered for the six outcomes of entry d93db0f, of which this outcome carries 37 per cent. The organizer-run experiment executes the search on one context per trial and returns root-instance pairs (counter 0, flags 11); it measures neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. Part of the transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S8, S9, VP, G7, G15, W and BL) and part is assumed in (i). Part (ii) is an assumption: the bound rho_c <= 0.0065 is not measured and cannot be measured at full size, since a context holds a listed good trial with probability about 2^-52.459. The clustering factors that support it are measured for the E1 outcome and for the filter's pass with it, not for listed good trials: the joint event, about 2^-92.5 per trial, is not reachable, so carrying these factors to it remains the premise. The walk evidence is for walks of seven full blocks with t_hi below 2^19 and for the 8-bit rig, not for this package's eight members with t_hi below 2^16 at 32 bits; t_hi enters only K1.a1. The 8-bit runs are evidence under the model's uniform free words, not at 32 bits.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. For an outer step of the run let I_E be 1 when its test-(2) mask meets S and I_2 be 1 when it passes the filter for S. Premise: for a uniform walk step U, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), Pr(I_E(U) = 1) <= 1.000106 * 47,608,704 / 2^32 and Pr(I_2(U) = 1) <= 1.001312 * 14,110,208 * 47,608,704 / 2^64, the exact shares of Section 8 for S = {285020a0} (2^-6.4953 and 2^-14.7450) times the declared factors. Use, proved given the premise: each budget is its premise mean over the RUN_STEPS = 1,609,629,931,472,932,569,088 outer steps, rounded up, plus 2^19 s with s = ceil(sqrt(10 RUN_CONTEXTS)): E_BUDGET = 17,844,352,998,343,204,095 E lanes and PASS_BUDGET = 58,786,108,504,052,059 passing outer steps. Both counts add up independent per-context counts between 0 and 2^19 (Lemma CX), so Hoeffding's inequality over the contexts bounds each overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20); with the credit and live-block tails, all four lie within the allowance 2 * 10^-8. A count above its budget can make the work register W pass WB and halt the run with failure; the time bound charges WB + W_CTX. The number of outer steps that reach the solver needs no budget: a passing lane's units include its preflight, and the screen and the solver are paid from the credit of H5screen-screen-and-capped-solver (GPT Sol, answer AW 5).
heuristics.scope: The counts N_E and N_2 of proof.md 10.3, taken over all RUN_STEPS outer steps, every step of every member of every context (9.1, 9.8): per context, each count lies between 0 and 2^19, the contexts are independent, and the mean per context is 2^19 times the indicator's probability for a uniform walk step (Lemma CX (c)); the two indicators of one outer step may depend on each other in any way.
heuristics.extrapolation: The nominal shares are exact for uniform independent (Y9, omega) (the certificate of Section 8, read for bit 3, and the program of Section 18). The factors are the least on a grid of one part per million that pass a lower-tail Chernoff test at exp(-7), (m - k)^2 >= 14 m with m = 2^38 * factor * share, on the counts of this entry's preregistered sample of 2^38 uniform walk steps of real outer steps (proof.md Section 13, plan PLAN2.txt sealed before the run): 3,047,071,463 steps whose omega passes (2) for 285020a0 (1.0000375 of the exact share) and 10,011,416 passing steps (1.000128). For the six outcomes of mask 5f of entry d93db0f the same rule on its 2^39 front-line steps gave 1.000026 and 1.000176, and its walk-context runs bounded both shares below those factors; those runs concern the earlier S. The declared experiment reports its E lanes and passes per trial (proof.md 9.2).
heuristics.limitations: The bounds on the indicators' probabilities are not proved: Y9 and omega are not proved independent and uniform, on the front line or on the walk. The factors rest on preregistered samples from pseudorandom generators under an independent-draw reading of the tests, which is an evidence limitation, not a proof of the physical means. The walk samples walk seven full blocks with t_hi below 2^19; this package's walks take t_hi below 2^16. The time bound, the filter and the pre-check do not depend on these shares; if a count passes its budget the work register can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability only.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12. For an outer step of the run, before any halt, let D be the debit bound of proof.md Lemma UM: for S = {285020a0}, D = 84 + 8,080 [the joint screen of the row holds] when the pre-check keeps the row, and D = 0 otherwise. Premise: for a uniform walk step, and hence for the mean over the outer steps of one context (Lemma CX (c)), E[D] <= F_S * u_M', with F_S = 1.009 and u_M' = 373,060,374,780,870,880,395,264 / 2^85 = 0.0096433847..., the exact mean of D in model M (Lemma UM). It concerns the joint law of Y9, omega, the member, C2.c1 and C2.b1 of the walk. Use, proved given the premise: every call debits at most D and at most CM(T) + ds(T) <= 8,164 (Lemmas ME and UM); the per-context sums of debits are independent, lie between 0 and L_C = 8,164 * 2^19 and have total mean at most m_C = ceil(F_S RUN_STEPS u_M') = 15,661,981,125,431,702,289, so Bernstein's inequality over contexts puts the probability that they exceed CREDIT - 8,164 below exp(-20); outside that event every preflight passes. The credit is 15,663,618,717,374,826,416. The time bound charges the whole credit whether or not the premise holds; success 0.39 holds under H1', H4', H_G_cluster and this premise (proof.md 10.3, 10.4).
heuristics.scope: D for every one of the RUN_STEPS outer steps of proof.md 9.1, that is, for every step of every member of every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts (9.8), as a function of the context's outer words, the member and t_hi, with S = 0x08 (the row 285020a0), the masks X of the filter of Section 8, nu by formula (V) of 9.7 and the screen of 9.9; the mean is over all outer steps, passing or not, with the zeros counted.
heuristics.extrapolation: u_M' is exact in model M (proof.md Lemma UM: Y9, omega, C2.c1, C2.b1 independent uniform words, a uniform member): a call has probability pi / 4 and a row that passes the screen ZETA_285 / 2^85 = 38,662,029 / 2^45, with the integers of Lemma ZC computed by the program of proof.md Section 18. Measured and preregistered, untrusted by the harness (proof.md Section 13): on 2^38 uniform walk steps of real outer steps, the mean of D was 1.00254 of u_M' (2,503,847 calls, 302,867 rows passing the screen, 1.00271 of the model share), and the rule fixed before the run gives F_S = 1.009; the screen agreed with an independent depth-first search on every call. An earlier preregistered run for the six rows of mask 5f found 1.00128 of that set's u_M'.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the words of the sampler are not proved to have the law of model M, so u_M' is not a property of the sampler. The preregistered sample uses one pseudorandom generator and independent uniform walk steps, not whole walks; it measures a mean, which is all the credit needs. If the premise fails, the credit can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound. This premise replaces H5_exec of entry d93db0f, a premise on the mean executed ledger with a cited model bound.

heuristics.statement: Supporting; stated for the advice record of proof.md Section 12; the fill premise of our entry 244f068c, restated for the walk (GPT Luna 5.6, answers D48, D49 and D54). For a context C of the run let G(C) be the number of its scan batches, counted without halts: the sum of ceil(n / 7) over its live blocks of n steps, a block being live when the automaton of test (2), stopped after the 16 bits of omega that the block fixes, is live (proof.md 9.8, Lemma BL); G(C) is at most BMAX = 74,912, and each batch has at most one fill. Premise: for a context with uniform outer words and members, E[G(C)] <= 1.002793 (7,072 / 2^16) BMAX: on average over the contexts a block is live at most 1.002793 times as often as a uniform low half of omega, 7,072 of whose 2^16 values leave the automaton live, whatever the block's size. The factor 1.002793 = 1,002,793 / 10^6 is chosen from the evidence: the least on the grid of 10^-6 at or above the live ratio of our preregistered walk sample plus four standard errors over its contexts, and above the empirical Bernstein bound of the same counts at confidence 1 - exp(-7) (proof.md 10.3). Use, proved given the premise: the list method of proof.md 9.8 budgets live blocks, not batches, and uses the premise in the per-block form stated after its colon; summed over the at most 16 blocks of a context, the number L(C) of its live blocks has E[L(C)] <= 1.002793 (7,072 / 2^16) 16. The live-block budget is LIVE_BUDGET = ceil(1002793 * 7,072 * 16 * RUN_CONTEXTS / (10^6 * 2^16)) + 16 s = 5,315,571,306,619,346 with s = ceil(sqrt(10 RUN_CONTEXTS)); the L(C) of the contexts are independent and lie between 0 and 16, so Hoeffding's inequality over the contexts bounds the overflow by exp(-2 s^2 / RUN_CONTEXTS) <= exp(-20); a halt only stops live blocks. Live blocks above the budget can make the work register W pass WB and halt the run with failure; the time bound charges WB + W_CTX, and the words and partial words of the lists, bounded by the E lanes and the live blocks (proof.md Lemma LM), need no premise.
heuristics.scope: G(C) and L(C) for every one of the RUN_CONTEXTS contexts of proof.md 9.1: eight members, each walking t_hi below 2^16 in at most two blocks of constant X0 >> 16 (Lemma W), the live blocks read through the lists of their passing high halves; the mean is over contexts with uniform outer words and members.
heuristics.extrapolation: If the low half of omega on a block were uniform, a block would be live with probability exactly 7,072 / 2^16 = 0.1079101 (Lemma BL), and E[G(C)] and E[L(C)] would be at most that share of BMAX and of 16. Measured and preregistered on walk contexts (PREREG_CO; proof.md 10.3 and Section 13): over 2^24 walk contexts with seven full blocks each, the contexts with 0, 1, .., 7 live blocks numbered 14,219,206; 211,101; 242,906; 280,108; 266,803; 273,538; 280,728; 1,002,826; so 12,676,289 of 117,440,512 blocks were live, a ratio of 1.000257... to 7,072 / 2^16 with a standard error of 0.000634 over the contexts, whose blocks are strongly dependent. The ratio plus four standard errors is 1.0027920..., and the empirical Bernstein bound at confidence 1 - exp(-7) 1.002753, both below the declared 1.002793. The E share of a walk step, the same average weighted by the high halves that P16 lists, is 0.99999857 +- 0.0000035 of p_E over 2^39 walk contexts (one-sided upper bound 1.0000152). In the four whole contexts that the participant walked with the declared program, 11 of 64 blocks were live (proof.md 9.2). The live low halves of omega are the same 7,072 for S = {285020a0} as for the six outcomes of entry d93db0f (the automaton of (2) after 16 bits does not depend on the row; counted over all 2^32 words by this entry), so the evidence applies unchanged.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: the low half of omega on a block is a function of the outer words, whose law the construction does not make uniform. The factor rests on one preregistered sample from a pseudorandom generator, whose live counts were reported rather than tested by a rule fixed in advance; it was chosen from them after the run, as the factors of H4' were chosen from prereg7. The sample walks seven full blocks with t_hi below 2^19, not this package's two blocks per member with t_hi below 2^16; the premise asks the live share not to depend on a block's size. If the premise fails, live blocks above the budget can halt the run with failure, which lowers the success probability and not the time bound.
